mapper.select: SELECT pra.id, pra.project_id, gj.job_id AS generation_job_id, pra.web_view_link, pra.mime_type, pra.size_bytes, pra.checksum_sha256, pra.duration_ms, pra.width, pra.height, pra.fps, pra.status FROM project_render_artifacts pra JOIN projects p ON p.id = pra.project_id JOIN generation_jobs gj ON gj.id = pra.generation_job_id WHERE pra.project_id = #{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND gj.job_id = #{jobId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND gj.job_type = 'RENDER_PROJECT' AND p.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL AND pra.status = 'READY' LIMIT 1
